top_signals.title: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
top_signals.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation added to Nvidia's market woes, with the stock already in a downward slide since early October.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
